# Third Party Dependencies

A major goal of this project is to be very judicious about which third party
dependencies we include. Limiting performance overhead, complexity, and bloat
is very important.

# xao

My tiny C XML parsing library. Released on my GitHub separately so idk makes
sense to put in 3rdparty.
